On this plot I grow beans mixed with some maize, and since Iringa usually gets good rains, I will not irrigate but I will spread cattle manure and a small bag of urea I bought with the voucher. I keep my own bean seed from last season, so I will not buy new seed, and I do not use chemicals for pests on food crops like this. My wife and children will do most of the hoeing and weeding, but I will hire about two weeks of labor to help with planting and harvest when the work is heavy.
